title: Miller Outdoor Theatre

services.name: School Groups
services.desc: Miller Outdoor Theatre offers culturally rich and artistically diverse children’s programming and daytime shows as part of its season of free productions. Children’s musicals, theatre, and productions are scheduled during the week, April through October. Performances begin at 11:00 a.m., unless otherwise noted, and end by 12:00 p.m. Miller Outdoor Theatre’s children’s programs are entertaining, educational, and - best of all - FREE! Seating at the Theatre is on a “first come, first served” basis. NO TICKETS ARE NECESSARY. NO RESERVATIONS CAN BE MADE.
